description: This file implements a WGL (Windows OpenGL) rendering context initialization and management class, including context creation, extension handling, and buffer swapping.

classes.name: WGLWindow
classes.description: A class managing a Windows OpenGL (WGL) rendering context, including initialization, context creation, extension handling, and buffer swapping.

methods.name: initializeGL
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL resources, creates WGL context with specified attributes, and loads necessary extensions.

methods.name: destroyGL
methods.description: Destroys the WGL context and releases device context resources.

methods.name: isGLInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the OpenGL context has been successfully initialized.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes the WGL context current for the calling thread.

methods.name: setSwapInterval
methods.description: Sets the swap interval for buffer swapping (vsync).

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the front and back buffers.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Checks if there was an error in the WGL context.
